task: Migrate package-interface tests to the Phase 26.1 R2 source freshness contract.
observation: Several earlier source-free fixtures removed provider source after producing .mossi. Under R2 these are stale packages, so tests failed before reaching their intended imported-interface assertions. Keeping the provider package intact and moving the consumer into a separate package preserves .mossi semantic loading while source bytes serve only freshness validation.
impact: The test migration now separates package-source freshness from imported semantic-interface coverage and prevents binary-only fixtures from being mistaken for supported packages.

resolution.summary: R2 requires source-backed package freshness; the migrated borrowed-reads and focused F1 interface tests pass. Full make check and the remaining F1 gates are tracked separately.
